messages.text: Cererea ta a fost trimisă spre analiză unui consultant. Referința ei este APP-00000001. Nu s-a luat încă nicio decizie.

assumptions: Product personal_loan_fixed version 2026-10-15 (synthetic parameters).
Simulation date 2026-10-28; the credit is paid out in full on that date.
Instalments are monthly; DAE uses equal months of 1/12 year (OUG 50/2010, Annex 1).
Amounts are rounded to 0.01 per instalment; the last instalment absorbs rounding.
Base rate 8.55% (product minimum (no risk-based rate provided)); fixed for the whole term.
Affordability uses the declared net monthly income and existing payments, unverified.
Net amount paid out: 29800.00 RON; requested amount is total credit including financed costs.
DAE/APR: 9.58%; nominal interest is not the total cost of credit.
No salary-account discount or optional insurance is assumed; annuity repayment, no first-home uplift.
Total upfront fees/premiums: 200.00 RON; total recurring charges: 300.00 RON.
Fees include upfront and recurring charges over the full term. Do not add them again to total repayment or total cost.
ANALYSIS_FEE: 200.00 RON (financed and deducted from payout).
Simulation debt-service ratio: 0.1647; limit: 0.40; within limit: true. Indicative check against BNR Regulation 17/2012; not an eligibility decision.
Indicative simulation based on synthetic product parameters and the stated assumptions. It is not an offer, an approval or an authoritative settlement amount.
